fleet_costs_modifier_desc.value: Our naval ambitions directly reflect on the budget of the country, more and more enterprises will be required to process metal, create weapons, logistics and finance projects. The stronger we want to become the #1 naval power in the world - the stronger it will affect the potential of our industry.

allied_africa_control_modifier_desc.value: Control over African territories provides industrial bonuses. Each controlled territory above the Axis adds +0.5% to industrial capacity and production efficiency.

axis_africa_control_modifier_desc.value: Control over African territories provides industrial bonuses. Each controlled territory above the Allies adds +0.5% to industrial capacity and production efficiency.

ENG_iraq_under_control_desc.value: Control of Iraq provides access to additional oil resources, increasing fuel production.

BLHM_GER_invest_in_italian_industry_desc.value: Italy is too industrially weak to be a reliable ally. We must help it move onto a war footing as quickly as possible.

BLHM_GER_libyan_industry_desc.value: Prospecting and developing Libya's resource-rich deposits will provide additional materials for the war machine.

BLHM_GER_spanish_african_bases.value: Treaty with Spain for African Bases

BLHM_GER_spanish_african_bases_desc.value: Disrupting enemy trade routes effectively requires deep logistics. Spain's neutral status works in our favor: the Allies cannot attack their bases, while Germany can use them to repair the fleet.

BLHM_GER_prepare_east_african_sabotage_d.value: Germany will prepare disruptions against enemy supply routes to be better positioned for the African campaign.

BLHM_GER_prepare_east_african_sabotage_t.value: Unlocks the §YPlan Scorpion§! decision after Italy enters the war.

BLHM_GER_mediterranean_exercises_desc.value: The command has decided that fighting on several fronts requires better preparation of our allies for the coming war.

BLHM_ITA_german_industrial_aid_desc.value: German investment and specialists help Italy accelerate its transition to wartime industry.

BLHM_GER_investments_in_libya_desc.value: Developing Libyan deposits temporarily diverts German construction and industrial resources.

BLHM_GER_german_army_training_desc.value: German instructors prepare the army for war across the wider Mediterranean theater.

BLHM_GER_plan_scorpion_desc.value: We are ready to sabotage Allied railways in the African region to temporarily disrupt enemy logistical routes.

BLHM_GER_plan_scorpion_effect_tt.value: Sabotages all railways, supply hubs, and ports in the selected East African regions.

category_infantry_light_desc.value: Lower-quality infantry units with reduced soft attack but improved supply efficiency. Includes militia, irregulars, and other improvised formations.

category_infantry_standard_desc.value: The backbone of any army. Standard infantry provides a balanced mix of firepower, organization, and supply consumption.

category_infantry_heavy_desc.value: Elite infantry units with enhanced soft attack and organization. Includes special forces, motorized, and mechanized infantry.

light_infantry_desc.value: A lightly equipped infantry battalion with reduced soft attack but lower supply consumption and organization requirements. Ideal for cavalry and mobile divisions.

heavy_infantry_desc.value: A heavily equipped infantry battalion with enhanced soft attack and organization. Higher supply consumption and training time reflect the elite status of these troops.
